name: stockout-prevention
description: Monitors FBA inventory health, identifies stockout risks from sales velocity, and orchestrates prevention actions — primarily inbound-shipment gap analysis and restocking. Triggers on: inventory check, stockout risk, FBA stock levels, days of cover, days of supply, replenishment, "am I going to run out". Do NOT use for: catalog management, new product listings, advertising, or order fulfillment.
